utterance:
Chloe, your urine test and examination fit a simple bladder infection (cystitis) — no signs it has spread to your kidneys. Plan:
- Trimethoprim 300 mg, one tablet at night for 3 days. It doesn't affect your pill.
- Drink plenty of water; paracetamol or ibuprofen for the discomfort. Urinary alkalinisers (like Ural) can ease burning but don't take them at the same time as some antibiotics — trimethoprim is fine.
- Because you're under 30 and it's been over a year, I've also sent a routine chlamydia and gonorrhoea test — it's a standard check, not because I think you have it. We'll let you know results in a couple of days.
- Tips to reduce future infections: wee soon after sex, don't hold on, stay hydrated.
Please come back or see a doctor urgently if you get a fever, shivers, pain in your back or side, vomiting, blood in the urine, or if you're not improving within 48 hours or symptoms come back after finishing — then we'd send urine to the lab to check which bug it is. If your period is late, do a pregnancy test and let us know. Any questions?
reply: Thanks, that's what I thought. I'll take the antibiotics and drink more water. I'll come back if I get worse or if my period is late.
